# Fatahi Building

> Fatahi Building is a design-build firm serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. We design and build custom homes, whole-home transformations and additions, with the same team from first sketch to final walkthrough. Most of our work is in North York.

## Facts

- Name: Fatahi Building (legal name Fatahi Building Inc.)
- Type: design-build firm for residential custom homes, whole-home renovations and additions
- Founded: 2020
- Founder: Majid Fatahi, founder, lead designer and builder, with over 30 years of experience
- Client relations and project management: Farbod Fatahi
- Based in: North York, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Service-area business, by appointment
- Areas served: Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including Rosedale, Forest Hill, Lawrence Park, Midtown, The Bridle Path, York Mills, Willowdale and the rest of North York, Etobicoke, Scarborough, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, King City, Aurora, Newmarket, Mississauga and Oakville
- Phone: (647) 631-1211
- Email: info@fatahibuilding.com
- Website: https://www.fatahibuilding.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/fatahibuilding
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/fatahi-building-inc/

## How we work

- One team handles design, engineering, municipal approvals and construction.
- We work off a fixed price: the scope is settled first, a budget and schedule are built around it, and the price holds for the scope agreed on.
- We do not price a home from a photo or from a cost per square foot. A price is built on time spent on the property and on the drawings.
- From a first conversation to permits in hand is about five to six months of work on average for a custom home in Toronto. The Committee of Adjustment alone adds two to four months at minimum, and most homes need it.
- During construction, Majid is on site daily and clients receive a written progress report every Friday.
- Homes come with a 12-month warranty and scheduled check-ins.
- We also build homes designed by outside architects.

## Services

- [Custom homes](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/services/custom-homes): design and build of new custom homes in Toronto and North York.
- [Whole-home renovations and transformations](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/services/transformations): new layouts, new systems and a rebuilt interior within an existing home.
- [Home additions](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/services/additions): second-storey additions, rear additions and extensions.

## Areas we serve

- [Willowdale, North York](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas/willowdale): where most of our recent homes are.
- [York Mills, Toronto](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas/york-mills): where we are building now, on Old Yonge Street.
- [Vaughan](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas/vaughan), [Richmond Hill](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas/richmond-hill) and [Etobicoke](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas/etobicoke): areas we serve, with each municipality's own building rules summarized.
- [Full list of areas we serve](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/areas)

## Projects

- [Old Yonge, North York](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/projects/225-old-yonge): a new custom home with more than 8,000 square feet of living space, under construction. Three-car garage, heated driveway, elevator, walkout basement with 11-foot ceilings and radiant heated floors, full-height concrete foundation walls.
- Betty Ann and Farrell, Willowdale West, North York: two custom homes.
- [Poyntz, North York (2023)](https://www.fatahibuilding.com/projects/131-poyntz-ave): a modern custom home.
